title: All* Zipper Lines Are Given
author: Kainapple
rules:
One year ago today I posted my first puzzle to LMD:
All Arrows Are Given. I've since looked into making more 6x6s giving standard rulesets an unusual negative constraint, and not many of them work very well! Here's one that does work.

Rules:

Normal 6x6 sudoku rules apply.

Any pair of digits that are the same distance from the centre of a zipper line sum to the same total (the total may be different for different lines). For odd length lines, the total is the central digit.

Zipper lines in this puzzle must be either completely horizontal or completely vertical. All such length 3 and length 4 zipper lines are given.

That is, you could not draw any more of these straight zipper lines of length 3 or 4 into the finished puzzle grid, even those that overlap each other in any possible way. You may find there are zipper lines of length 5 or 6 though, and the central 3 or 4 cells (respectively) of these don't count as a separate zipper line (so wouldn't be given).
